dialogue.content: 本日はよろしくお願いいたします20時より始めさせていただきます
dialogue.English: Thank you for joining me today. We will begin at 8:00 p.m.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: (そろそろ始めていきますね)
dialogue.English: (We’ll get started shortly.)

dialogue.content: はい！よろしくお願い致します！
dialogue.English: Yes! Thank you!

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員ですまず初めにあなたの性別と年齢、社会人か、学生かを教えてください加えて、相談中はあなたのことをなんと及びすればよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. First, could you please tell me your gender, age, and whether you are a working adult or a student? Also, how would you like me to address you during the session?

dialogue.content: はい。女性、40代、社会人
dialogue.English: Yes. Female, in my forties, working adult.

dialogue.content: 佐藤でお願いします。
dialogue.English: Please call me Sato.

dialogue.content: 佐藤さんですね本日はよろしくお願いいたします今日はどんなことを相談されたいですか？
dialogue.English: Ms. Sato, it's a pleasure to meet you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 時間がないんです、、、
dialogue.English: I just don't have enough time...

dialogue.content: それで困っています。
dialogue.English: And it's really troubling me.

dialogue.content: なるほど...どんなことで時間がないのですか？
dialogue.English: I see... What is causing you to feel like you don't have enough time?

dialogue.content: いろいろです。1つ目は仕事です。
dialogue.English: It's many things. The first is work.

dialogue.content: 忙しすぎて、自分の仕事もままならい。
dialogue.English: I'm so busy, I can't even get my own work done.

dialogue.content: 上に、部下の指導まで手が回りません
dialogue.English: On top of that, I can't even get around to training my subordinates.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね...それは困ってしまいますね...
dialogue.English: I see... That must be very difficult for you...

dialogue.content: いつ頃からそんな状態なんですか？
dialogue.English: How long has this been going on?

dialogue.content: はい、、特に忙しくなったのはここ2ヶ月ほどです
dialogue.English: Yes... It's gotten especially busy in the last two months or so.

dialogue.content: 2か月もそんな状態だと気も休まらないですよね...
dialogue.English: Being in that situation for two months must be so stressful...

dialogue.content: はい、、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: つかれます
dialogue.English: I'm exhausted.

dialogue.content: 時間がないというのは、自分に充てられる時間がないということなんですね...
dialogue.English: So when you say you don't have time, you mean you don't have any time for yourself...

dialogue.content: 疲れてしまうのも無理ないと思います...
dialogue.English: It's completely understandable that you're exhausted...

dialogue.content: そうですね。仕事も残業ばかりで、家のこともできません
dialogue.English: That's right. I'm always working overtime, so I can't get anything done at home either.

dialogue.content: 小学生の子供がいますが、遊んであげることできませゆ
dialogue.English: I have an elementary school child, but I can't even play with them.

dialogue.content: そんな状態なんですね...いつもどのぐらいまでお仕事されているのですか？
dialogue.English: That sounds tough... How late do you usually work?

dialogue.content: 最近は21時を回ることが増えてきました
dialogue.English: Lately, I've increasingly been working past 9:00 PM.

dialogue.content: いっぱいいっぱいです
dialogue.English: I'm completely overwhelmed.

dialogue.content: え!?それは確かに遅いです...お子さんも寂しがってしまいますね...
dialogue.English: Oh my! That is certainly late... Your child must feel lonely...

dialogue.content: はい。帰るといつも寝ています。かわいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes. They're always asleep when I get home. I feel so bad for them.

dialogue.content: そうですよね...旦那さんは帰りは遅かったりするのですか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine... Does your husband get home late as well?

dialogue.content: 今は会社じたい忙しい時期で、みんなががんばっているなか、上司である自分だけが早く帰るのも無理ですし
dialogue.English: The company itself is going through a busy period, and with everyone working so hard, it's impossible for me, as their manager, to be the only one to leave early.

dialogue.content: なるほど...
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 旦那はいません。1人で育てています
dialogue.English: I don't have a husband. I'm raising my child by myself.

dialogue.content: このまま、頑張りすぎて、プツンといつか糸が切れてしまいそうで、、
dialogue.English: If I keep pushing myself this hard, I feel like one day I'm just going to snap...

dialogue.content: それは責任を感じてしまいますね...いっぱいいっぱいということが伝わってきます
dialogue.English: That's a heavy responsibility to feel... I can really tell how overwhelmed you are.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: どうすればよいのか、、、
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do...

dialogue.content: 相談していただきありがとうございます時間いっぱいまで、一緒にどうしていければいいか考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing this with me. Let's use our time today to think together about what we can do.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: では状況を整理して行きましょう２か月前あたりから忙しくなっていて、それは会社自体が忙しい時期だからという理由でよろしいでしょうか？それともほかに理由がありますか？
dialogue.English: Alright, let's sort out the situation. Things have been getting busier for about two months. Is that because the company itself is in a busy period, or is there another reason?

dialogue.content: はい。その理由だけです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's the only reason.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます繁忙期というのでしょうか、その時期は会社の皆さんが等しく夜遅くまで仕事をしているのですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So it's the busy season. During this period, is everyone at the company working late nights?

dialogue.content: はい。繁忙期ですが、まだまだ今年いっぱいまではこの状況が続くと思われます
dialogue.English: Yes. It's the busy season, and it seems this situation will likely continue for the rest of the year.

dialogue.content: みんな残っていますね、、
dialogue.English: Everyone is staying late...

dialogue.content: 最近は土日もでてることもあります。
dialogue.English: Lately, I sometimes have to work on weekends, too.

dialogue.content: それは憂鬱になってしまいますね...憂鬱だけでなく、お子さんのことも心配ですよね...
dialogue.English: That must be depressing... And not only that, you must also be worried about your child...

dialogue.content: はい。心配です。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm worried.

dialogue.content: 土日まで...体調は崩されていませんか？
dialogue.English: Even weekends... Have you been feeling unwell?

dialogue.content: 自分の親は遠いところに住んでいますし、体を壊しているので、助けを求めることもできませんし
dialogue.English: My parents live far away and they're not in good health, so I can't ask them for help.

dialogue.content: 疲労感はありますね。
dialogue.English: I do feel fatigued.

dialogue.content: 寝ても疲れが取れません
dialogue.English: Even when I sleep, I don't feel rested.

dialogue.content: 無理もないと思います...
dialogue.English: That's completely understandable...

dialogue.content: はい、、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 子供には本当に申し訳ないです、、
dialogue.English: I feel so sorry for my child...

dialogue.content: 心配です。
dialogue.English: I'm worried.

dialogue.content: そう思うのも無理はないと思います...部下の指導もしているということですが、何名ぐらいいるのですか？
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel that way... You mentioned you also train subordinates, how many are there?

dialogue.content: 10人です。部下もなかなか覚えが悪い人が多く、疲弊してます
dialogue.English: There are 10 of them. Many of them are slow learners, and it's exhausting.

dialogue.content: 10名は多いですね...考えるだけで疲れそうです...
dialogue.English: Ten people is a lot... Just thinking about it sounds tiring...

dialogue.content: はい、、部下にもきちんと教えれてないというのもあって、申し訳ないです
dialogue.English: Yes... and I feel bad that I'm not able to train them properly.

dialogue.content: 家庭でも会社でも、誰かのことを気にかけながら自分のことをするのは大変だと思いますすごく頑張っておられると思います
dialogue.English: It must be very difficult to take care of yourself while also worrying about others, both at home and at work. I think you are working incredibly hard.

dialogue.content: 社長は、今が頑張り時だから！といいますが、もう無理です
dialogue.English: The company president says, 'Now's the time to push hard!' but I can't do it anymore.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そうだと思います、疲れたということもあまり表には出せないのではないですか？
dialogue.English: I imagine so. Is it difficult for you to show that you're tired?

dialogue.content: 部下のうち、1人がうつになってしまい、休職しています。それもあって、その子の仕事のカバーでミスが多発しており、さらに悪循環になっているんです
dialogue.English: One of my subordinates became depressed and is on leave. Because of that, covering their work has led to frequent mistakes, and it's turning into a vicious cycle.

dialogue.content: わたしは、このままではみんな疲弊してしまう、と言っていますが、全く聞き耳もたずです
dialogue.English: I've said that everyone will burn out if this continues, but no one will listen.

dialogue.content: なるほど...自分だけ早く帰るわけにはいかないという言葉の重みが伝わってきます...
dialogue.English: I see... I can feel the weight behind your words when you say you can't be the only one to leave early...

dialogue.content: 佐藤さんの上司にあたる方は、このことに理解は示してもらえないのですね...
dialogue.English: Your own supervisor doesn't really show understanding about this, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい。ですので、このまま頑張るしかないんです
dialogue.English: Yes. So I have no choice but to keep pushing through.

dialogue.content: でもしんどくて
dialogue.English: But it's so tough.

dialogue.content: そうですよね...無理もないです...佐藤さんは、会社で今の心の内を打ち明けられるような方はどのぐらいいますか？
dialogue.English: I understand... That's natural... Ms. Sato, is there anyone at your company you can confide in about how you're feeling?

dialogue.content: 今の会社ではなかなか、、、違う部署には1人同僚がいるのでたまに話すくらいです
dialogue.English: It's difficult at my company... I have one colleague in a different department that I talk to sometimes.

dialogue.content: 身体もそうですが、今のままでは精神的に持たなくなりそうで心配です...何か気持ちが安らぐようなことがあればいいのですが...
dialogue.English: I'm concerned not only for your physical health, but also that you won't be able to hold on mentally if things continue like this... It would be good if there was something that could bring you some peace of mind...

dialogue.content: どうでしょうか
dialogue.English: I'm not sure.

dialogue.content: 子供もが、がんばってと応援してくれるので、それが唯一救いなのだと思います
dialogue.English: My child cheers me on, telling me "Do your best," and I think that's my only saving grace.

dialogue.content: 優しいお子さんですね気を張りすぎないように気を付けてもらいながら、少しでも精神的な負担をまずは減らしていきたいですよね...
dialogue.English: What a kind child. We want to find a way to first reduce your mental burden, while also making sure you don't push yourself too hard...

dialogue.content: 睡眠時間はどのぐらいとれていますか？
dialogue.English: How much sleep have you been getting?

dialogue.content: そうですね。ほんとは寂しいだろうに、、
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm sure they must be lonely, though...

dialogue.content: 睡眠時間は4～5時間くらいですね
dialogue.English: I get about 4 to 5 hours of sleep.

dialogue.content: よる家事をするとそのぐらいになってしまいますよね...朝が唯一お子さんと話ができる時間ですし、大切にしたいですね
dialogue.English: That's about how much it ends up being when you have chores to do at night... The morning is the only time you can talk with your child, so it's important to cherish it.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 子供との時間だけが心安らぎます
dialogue.English: The time I spend with my child is the only thing that brings me peace.

dialogue.content: それは良いことだと思います!!その時間を少しでも良い身体、精神状態で過ごせたらいいですよね...寝ても疲れが取れきれいな状態だとそんな時間も安らぎきれませんし...
dialogue.English: I think that's a wonderful thing! It would be great if you could spend that time in a better physical and mental state... If you're not well-rested, you can't fully relax even during those moments.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: もう少し、余裕がもてればいいのですが、、
dialogue.English: I wish I had a little more breathing room...

dialogue.content: 今寝るときにぐっすり眠るための工夫などは何かされていますか？
dialogue.English: Are you currently doing anything to help yourself sleep more soundly at night?

dialogue.content: 特にしていませんね、
dialogue.English: Not really, no.

dialogue.content: 余裕を持つのは今の状況だと大変ですよね...例えばですが、アロマやストレッチなど試して、少しでも睡眠の質を高めてみるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Finding breathing room in your current situation must be difficult... For example, how about trying something like aromatherapy or stretching to improve the quality of your sleep, even just a little?

dialogue.content: まずは今の疲弊した状態を何とかしてみるというところからかな感じたいのですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I feel that perhaps we should start by trying to do something about your current state of exhaustion. What do you think?

dialogue.content: なかなかそんなことを、考える余裕なんてありませんでした、、
dialogue.English: I haven't had the mental space to even think about things like that...

dialogue.content: まずは疲れをとりたいですね
dialogue.English: First, I'd like to get rid of this fatigue.

dialogue.content: オススメのストレッチなどありますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any recommended stretches?

dialogue.content: 常に忙しい状態ですと無理もないですストレッチやなどでは、股関節や背骨を大きく動かしたり、伸ばしたりするものが効果がありますね
dialogue.English: It's understandable when you're constantly busy. For stretching, things that involve moving and extending your hip joints and spine are effective.

dialogue.content: 股関節や背骨が効果あるんですねー知りませんでした
dialogue.English: Hip joints and the spine are effective? I didn't know that.

dialogue.content: 股関節と背骨の付近には自律神経が集中しているので、凝り固まって神経系統をほぐしてあげるといいと思います
dialogue.English: The autonomic nerves are concentrated around the hip joints and spine, so it's good to loosen up those stiff areas and relax the nervous system.

dialogue.content: 同じ姿勢も多いので体が凝り固まってるかもしれません
dialogue.English: I do stay in the same position a lot, so my body might be stiff.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。やってみますね
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: 今の仕事の状態をすぐに帰ることは難しいと思うので、まずはセルフケアの手段を改善していき、少しでもお子さんとの時間を浴していければと思います
dialogue.English: I think it will be difficult to change your work situation right away, so first I'd like to improve your self-care methods and hopefully make your time with your child better.

dialogue.content: そうですね。なかなか状況はかわりません
dialogue.English: That's true. The situation isn't likely to change soon.

dialogue.content: 失礼しました良くしていければと思います
dialogue.English: My apologies, I meant to say 'make your time better'.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: あとは会社でも仕事のことや、私生活のことを話せる人を増やして、もやもやした感情を吐き出していかなと滅入ってしまうと思うのですが、だれか話せそうな人はいますか？
dialogue.English: Also, I think it would be helpful to have more people at work you can talk to about your job or your personal life, so you can vent your frustrations before they get you down. Is there anyone you might be able to talk to?

dialogue.content: 違う部署の同僚なら話せるとおもいます。
dialogue.English: I think I could talk to a colleague in another department.

dialogue.content: たしかにそういうのは大事ですよね
dialogue.English: You're right, that is important.

dialogue.content: 我慢しないで、話せる人には話していくほうがいいと思いますよ精神的な疲労はまずは貯めない工夫をすることかなと思います
dialogue.English: I think it's better to talk to people you can confide in rather than holding it all in. The first step is to find ways to prevent mental fatigue from building up.

dialogue.content: 貯めないことですね。心にとめておきます。
dialogue.English: Not letting it build up. I'll keep that in mind.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます佐藤さんはとても前向きで、だれに対してもし真摯な方なので、ストレスも感じやすいのかもしれませんその真摯さをいい方向に働かせていければと思います
dialogue.English: Thank you. Ms. Sato, you are very proactive and sincere with everyone, which might also make you more susceptible to stress. I hope we can channel that sincerity in a positive direction.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。がんばってみます。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll do my best.

dialogue.content: 今のその真摯な姿勢を部下にも見せ続けていけば、いずれそんな佐藤さんに答えようと部下の方も今以上に助けてもらえると思うのですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If you continue to show that sincere attitude to your subordinates, I believe that eventually they will want to respond in kind and will help you even more than they do now. What do you think of that?

dialogue.content: そうですかね。
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: そうだとうれしいですね。
dialogue.English: I would be happy if that were true.

dialogue.content: そうなれることを私も心から信じております
dialogue.English: I sincerely believe that can happen.

dialogue.content: （すみません、お時間になってしまいました）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry, our time is up.)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: (尻切れになってしまいましたが、こちらで本日の)トレーニングを終了させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？)
dialogue.English: (I know we ended abruptly, but would it be alright to conclude today's training session here?)

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますでは終了を押します
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll end the session now.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.
